initialization: unchanged simultaneous exact warm initialization, charged to work
suffix_definition: normalize final cumulative own strategy_sum minus its copy at the first complete iteration crossing the left work boundary; retain original iteration time weights, no reset; zero-mass rows use frozen uniform legal fallback; never mutate learner arrays
fixed_opponent_modes: all four original saved final source modes in the same game/representation/traversal/seed group; both responder seats; opponent always stays frozen

forecast.cell_duration_source: original source batch phase=trained wall seconds, complete 64-identity selection
forecast.partition: fixed sorted source identities by index modulo three
forecast.required: strictly below maximum_own_seconds; otherwise stop before trajectory replay; not a timing guarantee

same_runtime_prefix: all 192 original work checkpoints reproduce state/average-policy fingerprints, exact work, iteration, RNG and visited-key semantics on the recorded source runtime; any mismatch stops the new study
observer_tests: read-only current/sum captures and suffix extraction preserve full raw arrays/current/average policies/RNG/keys/work against unobserved toy paths and frozen indexed backend; uniform/linear-average pairs have identical current paths under otherwise fixed rules; hidden-information signs and zero-support windows checked
metrics: own root values and achieved own reply fingerprints
raw current movement and uniform/linear current identity
suffix row and uniform-reach mass coverage overall and river
fixed-opponent target EV, within root, gain and identities
aggregation: all full controls once; sampled every fixed seed and arithmetic means, no confidence intervals; duplicate current policies across average modes labeled, not independent samples
figures: current exact-exploitability curves, sampled means and seed points
final whole/current/suffix within+extra bars, sampled means and seed points
fixed-opponent gain differences versus whole average, full, both seats
fixed-opponent gain differences versus whole average, sampled means, both seats

native_reference.name: OpenSpiel
native_reference.role: comparison-only scalar EV/BR/achieved OWN replies for all 512 self profiles and 2048 fixed-opponent target conditions; no reference strategy export/training

admission: publish protocol, implement meaningful correctness/serialization/partial-grid tests, full relevant base/optional local checks, both source-bound code CI jobs, source-bound toy observer correctness and fixed forecast, publish checked admission before new Holdem trajectory replay
publication: own results before independent native comparison for recorded study; fresh reproduction may use immutable ignored own staging; no overwrites or dropped failures
scope: diagnosis of already-known trajectories at the original 10m work limit; no budget extension, new feature/rule/remedy/default, fresh/global admission, selected winner or claim of convergence; current/suffix policies comparison only
hypotheses: Does the current policy retain the clipped within weakness, or does averaging retain earlier weak play? Report every checkpoint/seed/mode, not only the final one.
Do fixed current/suffix versus whole-average EV changes persist against every declared saved opponent mode? Snapshot/suffix gains do not establish a generally better learning rule.

prefix_runtime.requirement: recorded source runtime; any poker state/policy/work prefix mismatch stops without loosening precision; base 3.12 report replay is a separate tolerance-based check

cumulative_mass_archive: retain all three read-only own cumulative strategy_sum boundaries per case, packed legal unnormalized weights with source/menu/state/work hashes; archived suffix and whole policies must reconstruct from them without training
